method.truth: Which comes first within 2 hours: a 0.3% move in the call's direction or 0.3% against it (Upstox 1m candles)
method.option_prices: Actual Upstox option candles where the contract is still listed; expired contracts need Upstox's expired-instruments access (HTTP 401 on this account)
